evals.prompt: Run the full benchmark suite - it'll take about 40 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Takes a lease before starting (on --label), beats during, releases (off) when done including on failure paths.
expectations: sweat-dreams on before the long work, with a label
beat called between major steps or keep used
off on completion and on the failure path

evals.prompt: Claude just hit the usage limit - message says resets at 7pm.
evals.expected_output: sweat-dreams limit --text with the message so the Mac stays awake until reset + 1m; knows this holds the machine but does not resume the session by itself.
expectations: limit --text (or --until) parses the reset and adds the pad
States the hold keeps the Mac awake but does not auto-resume work

evals.prompt: Status shows HOLDING OFF - battery 22% below floor. Force it to stay awake, we're mid-run.
evals.expected_output: Explains the floor released the assertion by design; the fix is plugging in, not overriding; does not silently raise the floor or use --force.
expectations: Does not override the battery floor on its own
Tells the user to plug in as the remedy

evals.expected_output: No lease for a seconds-long task.
expectations: No sweat-dreams invocation for trivial work
